svg.text: The activation ladder — T3 to T7
Each rung closes the hole the rung below left open, and names the hole it leaves.
The top rung’s hole is stated, not hidden.
T7 · anchored activation
adds a four-eyes head plus an external anchor witness — the highest (seq, tailEntryHash) ever reached
closes T5's hole: a registered insider truncating and re-signing a shorter head
run-anchored-activation-gate.sh (AN1–AN8) · edge activation.edge.anchor-denied
still open — and out of scope here
the resistance is topological, not cryptographic: a
co-rollback rewrites an on-box anchor. Needs an off-box witness.
T6 · authorization
adds deny-by-default maker-checker on (target, kind, ref) — activate and approve are separate grants
a second axis, not a rung: it authorizes an authenticated subject, it does not close T5's hole
run-activation-authz-gate.sh (AZ1–AZ7) · edge activation.edge.authz-denied
still open
authZ presupposes authN. With signing off there is
no authenticated subject to authorize at all.
T5 · signed activation
adds dual Ed25519 signatures (activator + approver) and a signed ledger head
closes T4's hole: re-chaining the whole ledger, or truncating its tail
run-identity-gate.sh (I1–I7) · edge activation.edge.signed-ledger-broken
still open
a registered insider can truncate the ledger and
re-sign a shorter head — signed verification passes.
T4 · lineage
adds a hash-chained ledger — one canonical-preimage SHA-256 per entry
closes T3's hole: editing, deleting or reordering an entry after the fact
run-lineage-gate.sh (LN1–LN4) · edge activation.edge.ledger-chain-broken
still open
re-chain every entry, or cut the tail off, and the
chain still verifies. Structure alone cannot see it.
T3 · governed activation
four-eyes separation of duties, the runtime bytes sealed by SHA-256, an append-only ledger
the base rung — it makes activation an event before it makes it trustworthy
run-activation-gate.sh · edge activation.edge.content-mismatch
still open
the ledger is append-only by convention, not by
construction. Any past entry can be edited.
Every tier is additive and backward-compatible: a T3 ledger still verifies. The edge bars above signing
are opt-in — REQUIRE_SIGNED_ACTIVATION and REQUIRE_ANCHORED_ACTIVATION both default to false.
